description.narrow: Kota Kinabalu — главный городской транспортный gateway западного Sabah к Kinabalu/Kundasang; не используется как локальный климатический профиль горы.

migration.note: Real locality created from researched source data; legacy composite route hubs are retained separately for compatibility.

geography: Столица Sabah на западном побережье Борнео; городской берег обращён к South China Sea, а горный Kinabalu/Kundasang лежит далеко во внутреннем высотном поясе.

climate.summary: West/northwest Sabah has two rainfall maxima, with the main maximum around October and secondary maximum around June; February and August are relative minima. The coast remains humid and thunderstorm-prone.

annual_reference.caveat: Климатическая справочная норма/реанализ; не текущая погода и не прогноз.

transport.note: Для Kinabalu Park используются road transfers/автобусы в сторону Ranau–Kundasang.

marine.weather: Use the dynamic METMalaysia Western Sabah and Labuan waters forecast for wind/thunderstorms/wave height before island or coastal boat legs.

safety.caveat: Police district is not necessarily the same as the administrative district; unreported crimes are absent. These are absolute counts, not a population-normalized rate and not a safety score.

provenance.note: Gateway-only profile; city climate and crime require separate normalization.
